details.further_information: Qualifies to play for Republic of Ireland due to his grandmother. He is also eligible to represent Hungary through his Hungarian-born grandfather. Peterborough United received €1M from Blackburn Rovers after his transfer to Ipswich, adding to the originial fee of €2M (10% sell-on clause) Transfer to Ipswich Town fc has add-ons upto €11.60 M.
